text:
maria: Heads-up — team dinner this Friday near Kitsilano? Thinking casual pizza vs poke. Thoughts?
alex: Pizza sounds great. Fitzs? tiny place but 🔥 crust.
jordan: +1 Fitzs, but they are tiny — reservation?
maria: @alex can you check for 6:30 for ~8 people?
alex: Trying the phone now. hold on.
kai: If Fitzs is full, The Poke Guy on 4th has great bowls and fast seating. Good for mixed diets.
taylor: vegan options?
kai: The Poke Guy has avocado/edamame bowls. Fitzs can do a vegan pie if you call ahead.
maria: Update from Alex: Fitzs voicemail says they do walk-ins and a 1hr wait on Fri. They offered to take a callback list.
jordan: Hmm, 1hr is meh. Any other pizza recs nearby?
alex: Margherita at Nicli Antica is bomb, and usually faster. 3 min from the office.
taylor: I vote Nicli or poke. Also Tacofino on Burrard has late-night tacos if people want after-dinner snacks.
maria: OK poll — reply with the emoji for your pick: :pizza: for Nicli/Fitzs, :bento: for Poke Guy, :taco: for Tacofino.
snackbot: Poll created — react to cast vote. (auto)
jordan: :pizza:
kai: :bento:
taylor: :pizza:
alex: :pizza:
maria: :bento: (leaning healthy tonight)
alex: Current tally looks pizza 3, poke 2, tacos 0. I'll call Nicli now and put us on a list for 8 at 6:30.
alex: Nicli confirmed 8 people at 6:30, request for a corner table. They asked if we have any dietary restrictions.
taylor: I'm GF.
maria: noted. I'll DM Nicli about GF crust.
kai: Can someone add a nav link? map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/example-nicli-kits
jordan: If anything falls through, backup plan: Poke Guy (no reservation, quick) or Tacofino (reservations via phone).
maria: Perfect — I'll post final confirmation tomorrow morning. Thanks y'all :party_parrot: 
alex: See you Friday.
snackbot: Reminder set for Fri 5:30pm — "Team dinner: Nicli Antica (Kitsilano)"
